content: पर्यङ्कः .²1 A bed, couch, sofa; क्वचिद् भूमौ शायी क्वचिदपि च पर्यङ्कशयनः <ls>Bh. 2. 81</ls>. .²2 A palanquin. .²3 A cloth girt round the back, loins, and knees (by a person) when sitting on his hams; <ab>cf.</ab> अवसक्थिका. .²6 A particular kind of posture practised by ascetics in meditation, sitting on the hams; it is the same as वीरासन which is thus defined by Vasiṣṭha:-- एकं पादमथैकस्मिन् विन्यस्योरौ तु संस्थितं . इतरस्मिंस्तथैवोरुं वीरासनमुदाहृतम् .. पर्यङ्कग्रन्थिबन्ध <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Mk. 1. 1</ls>.
